subject: BUG + EDIT NOTICE: generateMipmaps averages BGR5A1 (43) texels as half floats -> garbage mips; fixing with a per-format mip codec (compute_frontend.m blit==4 loop + blit_encoder.inc generateMipmaps gate)
body: blit_encoder.inc sets job->mipComponentBytes=(format==43||format==115)?2:1 and compute_frontend.m's blit==4 CPU filter then decodes each 16-bit BGR5A1 texel as an IEEE half (tegu_mip_half_to_float) -> wrong colours in every generated level of BGR5A1 textures (QuartzCore's BGR5A1 blur pyramids are exactly this format per c6fc). Also every other format (RGBA16Unorm, RGB10A2, R16F/RG16F, 565, 4444, float32, sRGB...) is silently skipped ('level 0 intact'). Fix (new pure-C header gpu/metal/tegu/mip_codec.h, mine): decode texel -> 4 floats (unorm8/16, snorm8/16, half, float32, 5551, 565, 4444, 1010102, sRGB through the sRGB curve: Metal filters sRGB mips in linear space), box-average, encode with round-to-nearest; job->mipFormat replaces mipComponentBytes. Edits: compute_frontend.m only the blit==4 inner loop (call tegu_mip_downsample_texel), its Dispatch field reuse (mipComponentBytes -> carries the format), blit_encoder.inc generateMipmaps format gate -> tegu_mip_codec_supported. Integer formats stay refused (Metal does not generate mips for them). Will re-read compute_frontend.m right before the edit.
